commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
90+5' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Lorient have a corner.
90+4' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
90+2' Abdoulaye Faye (Lorient) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Abdelatif Kherradji didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

90+1' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Mory Diaw pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Arthur Avom (Lorient) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Mory Diaw has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
88' Felix Mambimbi (Le Havre) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
87' Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
85' Didier Digard has decided to substitute Thomas Delaine and he is replaced by Enzo Koffi Vinette (Le Havre).
85' A substitution has been made. Abdoulaye Toure is replaced by Felix Mambimbi (Le Havre).

84' Younes Namli (Le Havre) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
84' Lorient have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

83' Mory Diaw pulls off a fantastic save! Bamo Meite (Lorient) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out. Corner kick. Lorient will have an opportunity.
82' Yvon Mvogo leaps to intercept the corner kick from Younes Namli (Le Havre).
79' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) is about to take a corner kick.
78' Younes Namli (Le Havre) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. It will be a corner kick for Le Havre.
78' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Le Havre get a corner.
77' Didier Digard decides to make a substitution. Ally Samatta will be replaced by Damian Pizarro (Le Havre).
75' Lorient couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Mory Diaw (Le Havre) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
74' Substitution. Theo Le Bris is replaced by Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient).
72' The Le Havre players are exchanging some short passes.
68' Lorient enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

65' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
64' Sambou Soumano (Lorient) is penalised for holding. Abdelatif Kherradji signals a set piece.
63' Didier Digard prepares a substitution. Fode Doucoure is replaced by Younes Namli (Le Havre).
63' Here is a change. Yassine Kechta is going off and Didier Digard gives the last tactical orders to Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre).
63' Olivier Pantaloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) replacing Aiyegun Tosin.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sambou Soumano (Lorient) comes onto the pitch so that Mohamed Bamba can be given a rest.
60' The possession of the ball – 64:36.
59' Half-chance! Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) plays a pass into the box, but Yvon Mvogo reacts well to snuff out the attack.
55' Abdelatif Kherradji shows a yellow card to Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) for a tough tackle.
52' Arthur Avom (Lorient) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
51' Le Havre couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Yvon Mvogo (Lorient) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
50' Today's referee Abdelatif Kherradji rightly decides to book Montassar Talbi (Lorient) for his harsh tackle.

47' 1 - 1 The ball finds its way to Issa Soumare (Le Havre) after a confusing situation inside the goalmouth. He finds some space and easily knocks the ball in with his body and alters the score to 1:1.
47' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
46' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Le Havre have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+10' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+8' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45+6' The game is interrupted now, Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45+4' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
45+3' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 63:37.
45+2' A yellow card for a tackle by Ally Samatta (Le Havre). Abdelatif Kherradji doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
45+1' The Le Havre players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

43' What an opportunity! Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
41' The foul by Laurent Abergel (Lorient) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Abdelatif Kherradji.
40' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
37' Big moment in the game as the red card awarded to Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) is cancelled following the VAR review!
37' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Abdelatif Kherradji changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
36' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Lorient using VAR. Let's see what happens.
33' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) must have forgotten he already has a yellow card on his account today. He receives a second one and is dismissed.
33' Foul! Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Lorient are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
32' Goal disallowed! Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) scores but Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) makes a rough challenge and Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul.

29' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
28' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Le Havre have a free kick.
25' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Abdelatif Kherradji ignores the protests.
21' 0 - 1 Goal! Dermane Karim provides Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the right post. 0:1.
20' Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) brings an opponent down and Abdelatif Kherradji interrupts the game.
18' The ball falls kindly for Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
18' Loic Nego (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but Yvon Mvogo comes off his line to gather the ball.

17' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
15' Abdelatif Kherradji shows a yellow card to Arouna Sangante (Le Havre), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

11' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is out of play. Lorient will have a throw-in.
10' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
9' Great teamplay by Le Havre as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
4' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) misses the penalty as he smashes the ball against the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
4' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
3' Abdelatif Kherradji shows the yellow card to Bamo Meite (Lorient) for a heavy challenge.

3' Bamo Meite (Lorient) tackles a bit over-zealously and Abdelatif Kherradji blows for a foul. The referee gives a penalty to Le Havre after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
3' The resulting set piece from Le Havre is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Lorient will take the kick-off.
Abdelatif Kherradji will referee today's match.
